coverageNote: Scanned win32_host.c along every function reachable with host_is_128 (Win32Bootstrap 14856-15109 and callees: initialize_game_d3d, initialize/activate/render_game_app_128, resize_game_window, queue_* input path, get_hid_controller/mouse hooks, client-state hook, zip overrides, tcui/xbox patches, platform fixes, D3D/IAT hooks, crash trace, dispatcher, create_user_data). Every RVA_128_* macro and every inline RVA literal reachable on the 1.2.8 path (0x010296d1, 0x0015a080, 0x01569eac, 0x015684b8, 0x012b64b4, 0x012bfbcc, owner/renderer offsets, 0x00c00000 bounds, 0x02db1000 gate) is covered by a fact; RVA_128_DEBUG_*/FONT_*/COLOR_WHITE/DEVELOPMENT_VERSION_GETTER/D3D_CONTEXT_IID/D3D_ANNOTATION_IID are confirmed unused on the 1.2.8 path. All object-field offsets (+0x1c/+0x20, +0x330/+0x334, +0x3b4, adapter+4/+0xa8, controller +0x10/+0x28/+0xa0/+0xc9/+0x1f0, client +4/+0x18/+0x28/+0x44/+0x2c0/+0x378, owner +0x6c/+0xac/+0xc0/+0xd0, renderer +0x104/+0x110/+0x114/+0x118/+0x120/+0x124, keyboard+5, SceneStack stride 8), vtable slot indexes (23/24, 41/42, ClientInstance slot 3, zip slot 11, callback vtable[2], D3D slots 8/22/45), event/struct sizes (0x24, 0x64, 0x14, 0x10, 0x378, 0x1d0, display 0x20, GameStringX86 0x18, startup_context 0x40) and every call into game code (create_app_main, frame, setSize/windowSizeChanged, owner ctor/init_device/init_targets/release_targets/operator new, enqueue/mouse/key/text/map_virtual_key factories, string assign, zip original, original IAT functions) have a fact; I found no uncovered RVA, offset, byte pattern or calling-convention dependency in game-binary-facing code beyond the items listed. Spot checks with arm32re confirmed the vtable/IAT cells for ClientInstance slot 3 (0x133a764), mouse lambdas (0x1369c30/c14/c68), zip/directory getAsset (0x136e598/5e8/df2c), pickFile (0x1369630) and TCUI delay cells (0x15121fc). The remaining gaps are therefore mostly (1) verifier-corrected values not folded back into the JSON, (2) UNVERIFIABLE/medium facts, (3) open runtime-behavior questions recorded only in verdict 'missing' lists or open_questions, and (4) the uncovered fake-WinRT surface, create_user_data defaults and UI-layout heuristics. No fact was REFUTED; 3 CORRECTED (2 appmain, 1 input), 2 UNVERIFIABLE (winmain). Several verdict 'missing' items were already resolved by port_instructions (owner+0xb8=0x9100, r0-r3 hook forwarding, three zip originals, Win7 patches dropped) and are not repeated.
